description:
Add Jetpack Navigation Component with Bottom Navigation to the existing 'NavigationApp' project. 

1. Add the necessary dependencies to `app/build.gradle.kts`: `androidx.navigation:navigation-fragment-ktx` and `androidx.navigation:navigation-ui-ktx` (version 2.7.7 or compatible).

2. Create three new Fragments in `com.example.navapp`: `HomeFragment`, `DashboardFragment`, and `SettingsFragment`, along with their corresponding layout files (`fragment_home.xml`, etc.).

3. Create a navigation graph (`res/navigation/nav_graph.xml`) with these three fragments as destinations.

4. Create a bottom navigation menu (`res/menu/bottom_nav_menu.xml`) with three items corresponding to the destinations.

5. Update `activity_main.xml` to include a `FragmentContainerView` (acting as the NavHostFragment) and a `BottomNavigationView`.

6. Wire everything up in `MainActivity.kt` using `NavigationUI.setupWithNavController()` so that tapping the bottom tabs switches between fragments.

Ensure the project builds successfully.
